remarks: Welcome to Fairlawn, SAUGHT after community right in the heart of Stamford's Glenbrook neighborhood!!! Beautifully maintained, light and bright 2BD 2nd floor unit has just been freshly painted and is ready for its next loving tenant. Brand new flooring throughout, recessed lights in the living room, spacious bedrooms and even a walk in closet. For your convenience laundry room and an extra storage are located just a few steps down in the lower level. TWO parking spots!!! HEAT AND HOT WATER included in the rent and to top it off, beautifully landscaped grounds to enjoy peaceful nature walks. Minutes to beaches, Downtown Stamford's shops and restaurants, walk to Chelsea Piers. Easily accessible to I-95, right on the Darien border. GREAT CREDIT is a MUST!!! Don't wait...
